name: Headspace
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Headspace, play user-owned guided audio and maintain a private reflection log. The hard boundary is large licensed meditation library, clinical programs, coaches, brand, and mobile polish, plus hardware data, content, coaching, and trust.
